[[File:Ryan Morris DecipherCon 1999.png|thumb|right|Ryan Morris at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Ryan Morris''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 69 FL from Santa Barbara, Ca. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 23 (20 August 1999) interviewed him on [[Young Jedi]] decks, and he co-hosted broadcast 27 (8 October 1999) with [[Marcus Certa]].<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], wiki.lotrtcgpc.net (broadcast 23, 20 August 1999: "Guests : Ryan Morris"; broadcast 27, 8 October 1999: "Hosts : Marcus Certa and Ryan Morris"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014124409/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Internet Archive].</ref> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] he and [[Mark Tuttle]] ran Radio Free DecipherCon, Decipher's audio feed from the convention.<ref name="dc99-audio">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/audiofeeds/index.html DecipherCon 1999 audio feeds], Decipher (1999): "Meet Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle! - the voice and tech behind Radio Free DecipherCon." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005044012/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/audiofeeds/index.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dc99-fri32">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri32.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri32], Decipher (1999): "Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle, the men behind the voices of Radio Free DecipherCon." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000529023458/http://www.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri32.html Internet Archive].</ref> He joined Tuttle for the closing comments on Sunday.<ref name="dc99-sun">[http://www1.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/audiofeeds/SUN/index.html DecipherCon 1999 audio feeds: Sunday], Decipher (1999): "Closing comments....and that's all folks (M. Tuttle, R. Morris)". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010217090821/http://www1.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/audiofeeds/SUN/index.html Internet Archive].</ref> ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #43 printed his [[The Thrill of Victory (Star Wars Insider)|The Thrill of Victory]] on the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="insider-1998">Ryan Morris, "The Thrill of Victory", ''Star Wars Insider'' #43, pp. 64–65. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], Internet Archive.</ref><ref name="wook-43">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_43 Star Wars Insider 43], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200809061703/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_43 Internet Archive]</ref>
